subject: state in a signature default re-initializes per call (op/signatures.t t126/t127)
description: `sub f ($c = (state $s = $z++)) {}` — the default expr isn't scanned by the v2 state rename (statement-level only, Parser2 _rename_state_vars), so it lowers to a plain (p-scalar-= $s ...) against a forward-scan defvar'd global: re-inits every defaulted call, and the guarded-once cell/flag shape is missing. Body-level state in the same subs is correct. 5 suite rows (t126 276/277/280, t127 289/296). Fix direction: extend the state scan to signature default_exprs (named path), reusing the same cell+flag lowering; scope also covers `sub f ($a = state $x = 5, $b = $x)` cross-default visibility.
